LEXICAL ANALYZER - NATIVE C DESKTOP APPLICATION

1. Double-click LexicalAnalyzer.exe.
2. Click Load Sample, then ANALYZE CODE.
3. Try Error Sample to demonstrate lexical diagnostics.

Keep the samples folder beside the executable. No Python, Node.js, server,
compiler or installation is needed. Supported: Windows 10 version 1703 or newer
and Windows 11 x64.

Open C File, Save File, Clear Editor, Clear Results and Export Results work with
the actual source and scanner results. CSV exports contain the entire analysis,
regardless of filters. Double-click a token or diagnostic to select its source.

Shortcuts: Ctrl+O open; Ctrl+S save; Ctrl+Enter analyze/cancel; Ctrl+F search;
Ctrl+E export. The preserved console application is lexical_analyzer.exe.

Full source, reports and tests: https://github.com/prxns/Lexical-Analyzer
